answer: Sybil resistance here works by stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious forks by demanding verifiable work history. Forging N identities then costs N bonds plus the compute to fake consistent histories, far exceeding any reward. Like a river carving trust over time, reputation accrues slowly, so a sudden gale of new accounts stalls at the oasis of low weight until genuine, costly proof accumulates.
